column4: Prints the visit-this-link prompt on stderr for a command-line or startup login; decides nothing.
Writes the prompt text to a writer; decides nothing.
Starts a login for the web UI by handing its link and callback signal to the route and holding the token; the checks are in issue_token and the confirm step.
Saves, caches and publishes a grant the person already confirmed; the owner and attempt checks are in the confirm route.
Opens the browser and prints the link for a command-line or startup login, logging only the endpoint and path; decides nothing.
Formats an expiry as RFC 3339 for the status read.
Classifies a sign-in state for display; it gates no request.
Builds the sign-in status cell.
Stores the sign-in status for display.
Reads the sign-in status for display.
Moves a redeemed token into wiped buffers to hold until the person confirms; decides nothing.
Turns a confirmed grant into the token to save, shortening its lifetime by the time held; the confirm decision was made before.
Reads the confirm window a UI login carries, else the default.
Returns the default confirm window when the web UI is off.
Splits a UI login hook into its two channels.
Has no hook to split when the web UI is off.
Attaches the status cell a client publishes to.
Evaluates and publishes the sign-in status for display.
Writes the status a held token puts a client in, for display.
Derives the sign-in status from the issuer state and the held token; it describes, and gates no request.
Reads a held token as signed in or expired for display; the token check that gates a call is is_expired.
Records when a login ends, for the retry hint.
Reads when the login in flight ends, for the retry hint.
Reports whether a 3.x token file exists so the status can say a re-sign-in is needed; it reads nothing from it.
Chooses the static page a good callback shows; decides nothing.
The callback server start with the success page chosen; the state check is in the handler.
Reads the confirmed-sign-in count.
Counts a confirmed sign-in once its file is durable.
Stores a held token's expiry and refreshability for the status; it gates no request.
Hands out the login attempt whose finish a decision awaits.
Registers the login's client id, ending at a cancel or the deadline; the issuer check stays in issue_token.
Keeps the documents discovery fetched and loads the credential stored under their issuer; the checks are in discover_documents.
Stores the install key before the count is bumped.
Reads the latest install key.
Builds the hook that publishes a settled refresh to the status; it gates no request.
Builds the sign-in wait answer; the decision is in issuer_differs.
Reads the status cell's install count; the decision is in GrantAllowed::spend.
